===== EXP13: procs_priv exists? =====
Tables_in_mysql (procs_priv)
procs_priv
===== ROUTINE LEVEL: create procedure, grant EXECUTE =====
Grants for routine_user@localhost
GRANT USAGE ON *.* TO `routine_user`@`localhost`
GRANT EXECUTE ON PROCEDURE `mysql_priv_lab`.`count_emps` TO `routine_user`@`localhost`

===== ROUTINE: routine_user can CALL, cannot SELECT table =====
COUNT(*)
4
ERROR 1142 (42000) at line 1: SELECT command denied to user 'routine_user'@'localhost' for table 'employees'
